@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Look up! The flock of birds flying o______d is so beautiful!
= overhead
~詞義 overhead（adv.）在頭頂上
~原文 Look up! The flock of birds flying overhead is so beautiful!

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The suspect is under strict s______e because the police think he might try to escape.
= surveillance
~詞義 surveillance（n.）監視
~原文 The suspect is under strict surveillance because the police think he might try to escape.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Thomas g______ed for his wife, who had died of cancer, for many months.
= grieved
~詞義 grieve（v.）悲痛
~原文 Thomas grieved for his wife, who had died of cancer, for many months.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Mary raised her children well. They are c______s to people and well-behaved in public.
= courteous
~詞義 courteous（adj.）有禮貌的
~原文 Mary raised her children well. They are courteous to people and well-behaved in public.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Zack needs to buy an o______t that is suitable for formal occasions. Most of the clothes he owns are too casual.
= outfit
~詞義 outfit（n.）全套服裝
~原文 Zack needs to buy an outfit that is suitable for formal occasions. Most of the clothes he owns are too casual.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: People often remark on the ______ between Lily and her elder sister. They look almost identical.
A: credibility
B: originality
C: resemblance
D: sponsorship
= C
~詞義 resemblance（n.）相似
~原文 People often remark on the resemblance between Lily and her elder sister. They look almost identical.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The company hired a(n) ______ to help employees with stress issues and other mental health problems.
A: attorney
B: counselor
C: defendant
D: respondent
= B
~詞義 counselor（n.）諮詢
~原文 The company hired a(n) counselor to help employees with stress issues and other mental health problems.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The volcanic ______ covered nearby towns with hot ash, leading to heavy casualties.
A: eruption
B: lounge
C: republican
D: sparkle
= A
~詞義 eruption（n.）爆發
~原文 The volcanic eruption covered nearby towns with hot ash, leading to heavy casualties.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The speech was very long, and it was difficult for the audience to understand its ______.
A: butcher
B: essence
C: revenue
D: cemetery
= B
~詞義 essence（n.）本質
~原文 The speech was very long, and it was difficult for the audience to understand its essence.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The painting was sold for over two million dollars; it was the most expensive item in the ______.
A: auction
B: creek
C: outlet
D: premise
= A
~詞義 auction（n.）拍賣
~原文 The painting was sold for over two million dollars; it was the most expensive item in the auction.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: rip-off
B: indulges
C: rib
D: rifle
E: surplus
F: swap

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Linda and her sister sometimes ______ their handbags or clothes. This way, they can change their styles without buying more items.
= F
~詞義 swap（v.）交換
~原文 Linda and her sister sometimes swap their handbags or clothes. This way, they can change their styles without buying more items.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Dora ______ in reading fantasy novels to find comfort in magical worlds during stressful weeks.
= B
~詞義 indulge（v.）沉溺於
~原文 Dora indulges in reading fantasy novels to find comfort in magical worlds during stressful weeks.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: There is currently a(n) ______ of cabbages on the market. That is why they are so cheap.
= E
~詞義 surplus（n.）過剩
~原文 There is currently a(n) surplus of cabbages on the market. That is why they are so cheap.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The souvenir shop charged such high prices that tourists felt the items were a complete ______.
= A
~詞義 rip-off（n.）索取高價;敲竹槓
~原文 The souvenir shop charged such high prices that tourists felt the items were a complete rip-off.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The hunter held up his ______ and aimed it at the bear. He put his finger on the trigger and was ready to shoot.
= D
~詞義 rifle（n.）步槍
~原文 The hunter held up his rifle and aimed it at the bear. He put his finger on the trigger and was ready to shoot.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: decay
B: retailer
C: overtake
D: rhetoric
E: symbolic
F: utilize

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: In order to attract customers and boost overall sales, the ______ came up with several promotion strategies.
= B
~詞義 retailer（n.）零售商
~原文 In order to attract customers and boost overall sales, the retailer came up with several promotion strategies.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The rose that the man is holding in the painting is ______ of love and passion.
= E
~詞義 symbolic（adj.）象徵的
~原文 The rose that the man is holding in the painting is symbolic of love and passion.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Food that is left out in the open will start to ______ within hours. You should put it in the fridge.
= A
~詞義 decay（v.）腐敗
~原文 Food that is left out in the open will start to decay within hours. You should put it in the fridge.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Students should learn how to ______ the abundant resources that the school library offers.
= F
~詞義 utilize（v.）利用
~原文 Students should learn how to utilize the abundant resources that the school library offers.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Nick is a highly persuasive speaker. He uses strong ______ and personal charm to win his audience's approval.
= D
~詞義 rhetoric（n.）修辭
~原文 Nick is a highly persuasive speaker. He uses strong rhetoric and personal charm to win his audience's approval.
